about.description: GAIB is a governance and incentive token for its protocol ecosystem, enabling community decision-making and participation in protocol economics. It aligns stakeholder interests through tokenized governance.
about.registryInfo: GAIB (Gainz AI / Bond) is a tokenized AI-compute-infrastructure platform — issues tokens representing fractional ownership of GPU and AI-data-center compute capacity. Backed by Hack VC, Faction VC.

fees.revenueNotes: GAIB takes a structuring + ongoing servicing fee on each tokenized compute deployment, plus a performance fee on compute-rental net yield distributed to token holders.
